description: [Ncloud Storage] Download an object from a Ncloud Storage bucket as text (GET /{key}). Supports a specific versionId and a byte Range. A DEEP_ARCHIVE object must be restored first (ncloud_ncs_restore_object) or the call fails with InvalidObjectState.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

versionId.description: Version ID of the object (versioning-enabled buckets). Omit for the current version

name: ncloud_ncs_get_object
